text_block_list.text:
I can't believe how well that radio
recording went!
The director was over
the moon!
text_block_list.name: City's Manager

text_block_list.text:
Could you quiet down a bit? We don't
normally
get permission to leave our
dorms at this hour.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Oops, sorry, City! Anyway, get some
good rest,
all right?
text_block_list.name: City's Manager

text_block_list.text:
Haha, this is wild. I feel so energetic
from
finishing work. No way am I getting
any sleep
now.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Guess I might as well watch some race
footage
when I get back to my room.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Later, I hear a rumor that Голд Сити has
started
staying up late.
